basis: Regression ceilings for the maintained three-target Linux V11 journey plus the retained 48-file storage fixture. Before remediation the fixture used 1,656,908 logical bytes for two 336-item graphs and added 828,454 bytes unchanged; current normalized storage uses 691,245 bytes and adds 332,517 bytes. The prior Volicord campaign reached 25,179,035,785 logical bytes with approximately 1,008,546,677 bytes per full snapshot. The 2 GiB absolute ceiling is retained, the 512 MiB per-project post-warmup ceiling separates cumulative growth, and 2,048 bytes per inventory/entity/relation item is above the post-fix fixture while rejecting the repeated full-JSON fixture ratio.
